training_selection_rule: Highest public-training genome-fraction gain among configurations satisfying the prespecified chimera, assembly-size, and recovered-90 feasibility constraints; ties use mean recovery, lower chimera, and fewer rescue contigs.
claim_boundary: Selected using public CAMI III Toy samples 0 and 1. This frozen configuration is applied unchanged to held-out Toy pairs before any held-out gold-standard archive is downloaded.
